decision.explanation: Document d00 explicitly locates Chesapeake High School (Baltimore County) in Essex, Maryland; document d04 provides the specific address for Chesapeake High School in Pasadena, Maryland (Anne Arundel County); and document d02 identifies a distinct Chesapeake High School in Chesapeake, Ohio. Document d01 contains contradictory internal logic (claiming a Maryland school is in Orlando) and is rejected as unreliable.
